// ContentSource: File reads Content/ on disk (dev + authoring). Prod overrides this to Cosmos.
// Audio: Server-side read-aloud (Azure Speech neural voices, cached as MP3 blobs). Empty values disable it — the web then falls back to the browser voice. Auth is DefaultAzureCredential; set the real values in prod app settings / appsettings.Development.json.

Audio.// VoiceAliases: Stable voice aliases (<gender>-<region>-<n>) that book casts name, mapped to real Azure neural voices. Site chrome, not book data: only ever ADD an alias or REMAP one to a new voice of the same gender and accent; never remove one or reuse it for a different gender/accent. Remapping re-synthesizes exactly the audio that uses it. App Service can override one as Audio__VoiceAliases__female_us_1 (underscores stand in for hyphens).
